profile.headline: Founder | Mobile Software Engineer | Apple WWDC16 |  Visionary ⚡️
profile.summary:
I’m a mobile engineer and product builder with 10+ years of experience designing and scaling iOS applications from idea to production.

Over the course of my career, I’ve focused on building products that solve real problems, combining strong technical execution with product thinking and user experience. I’ve led engineering teams, mentored developers, and delivered systems supporting 100K+ users.

Most recently, I founded and built Moxy Messenger, a mobile communication scheduling platform used by thousands of users, where I led everything from architecture and system design to product strategy and growth. I’ve also driven measurable improvements in engagement and retention, including achieving 30%+ gains through product and UX enhancements.

Previously, I served as an Engineering Manager at Homebase, where I led a remote team delivering tools used by 100K+ businesses across the U.S. and Canada. My work has included modernizing mobile systems, improving team performance, and delivering scalable features during high growth periods.

I enjoy working at the intersection of engineering, product, and business. Building systems that scale and experiences that users actually value. I’m currently exploring opportunities where I can contribute as a Mid-level mobile engineer, technical leader, or product-focused builder.

Recently, I’ve also been exploring AI-integrated mobile experiences and how LLMs can enhance user workflows within modern applications.

If you’re building something meaningful, I’d love to connect.

positions.title: Founder & Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Moxy Messenger is a versatile mobile app designed to streamline and enhance communication by enabling users to schedule and send messages across multiple platforms. It supports SMS, iMessages, emails, and various social messaging platforms such as WhatsApp, Slack, Messenger, and GroupMe. This app is particularly useful for those who need to manage communications efficiently, such as business professionals, students, and busy individuals.

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
positions.description:
• Led a remote team of mobile engineers as we refactored our mobile messaging feature used by more than 100K small business owners
• Served as a mentor for new hires joining our Engineering Bootcamp
• Collaborated with Product, QA, and CX teams in an Agile environment 
• Increased company ARR by $4M

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Throughout my four years as an iOS Engineer, I worked on our mobile and iPad apps. During this time, we made efforts refactoring legacy code from Objective-C to Swift in addition to creating new features to support small businesses during the COVID pandemic.
I also lead our Engineering Bootcamp, being a mentor for new engineers in our 2 week orientation.

positions.description: As an individual contributor, I also worked with QA and managed our App Store and Google Play submission & release process.

projects.title: Quik Card
projects.description:
Quik Card creates and manages QR codes for all of your profiles, websites, and contact info. Connecting on TikTok, accepting payments on Cash App, and sharing your online store are now all possible from one app.

I wanted to create a way to improve the way we connect IRL. Instead of telling people your usernames/websites and hoping the spelling is correct, or having to enter it for them, I’ve created a main hub for sharing profiles and info.

projects.title: Quest - Travel ETA
projects.description:
Quest is aimed to assist in the communication of travel arrival. Get quick arrival times to all of the places around town.

No matter where you are in the world, let Quest put an end to the guessing.


• Know ahead of time with real-time ETAs
• Find all of your favorite locations
• Let your friends or family know when you'll arrive via text
• Get quick updates for your frequent destinations like Home & Work
• Access directions through Apple Maps


Whether on your morning commute, meeting friends in town, or simply heading home, I believe we all value the importance of communication and being on time.
